M5: Energy Governance for a Just Energy Transition
This chapter provides a foundational understanding of energy governance and its critical role in ensuring a just energy transition.
It explores governance principles, challenges, and frameworks necessary for navigating the global shift toward clean energy while addressing economic, social, and environmental inequalities.

This lesson defines governance and energy governance, emphasizing their critical role in shaping decision-making, managing trade-offs, and ensuring a just energy transition, and discusses the three principles of effectiveness, inclusinvess and accountability
This lesson explores energy governance four pillars(focus areas), including inclusive institutions, regulatory frameworks, civic engagement, and oversight mechanisms.
Lesson 3: Cross-Cutting Approaches to Energy Governance

This lesson highlights four essential cross-cutting approaches—people-centered inclusivity, multi-level governance, digital enablement, and flexibility—demonstrating how they enhance the effectiveness, transparency, and adaptability of governance systems to support just and sustainable energy transitions.
